note: Ant; medial stress, short vowels as printed; important distinction from Gilgit philiili mora variants.
Ass; unmarked, source identifies regional/Kashmiri loan.
Bear; final stress, Purik loan.
Bird; two-word expression, initial stress on first; exact o quality approximate.
Bull; two Purik alternatives, second final-stressed.
Bumblebee; medial stress, three syllables.
Male cat; final stress, long barred/central u normalized as uu. Indo-Aryan loan bil base.
Second cat row (misprinted cat m. again; neighboring forms are feminine) gives same Brokskat form as131. DB lee bi' is a reading/order error, not a distinct initial-stressed feminine.
Crow; unmarked long vowel.
Cow; unmarked long vowel.
Dog; unmarked long vowel.
Egg; unmarked, source identifies Kashmiri loan.
Feather; final stress, Purik loan.
Fish; unmarked nasal long vowel, Purik loan.
Flea; initial stress, retroflex/underlined z.
Male goat; two alternatives with different accent and formation; miar has unequal vowel sequence.
Second goat row (female forms despite repeated m. label); three alternatives, first two initially stressed. These cannot be merged into one inherited goat form.
Hen; two-word Purik expression, no stress marked.
Horn; the acute IS printed in the Brokskat cell on short i. It can indicate syllable prominence here, but not a long-vowel mora contrast.
Horse; y/glide has an underscript nonsyllabicity-like mark in print, omitted in this normalized surface. No stress is marked; do not count y as an independent mora-bearing vowel here.
Louse; unmarked long vowel.
Nit; apostrophe printed between c̣ and aa, final vowel stressed. Morpheme/syllable boundary interpretation requires care.
Mouse/rat; INITIAL stress and doubled barred/central u, not stored mau. Exact quality approximate, accent secure.
Rooster; correct order byaa pho, unmarked Purik expression; DB reverses it.
Sheep; FINAL stress is printed, not the DB's initial acute nílo. Initial n is present. This is a genuine final-o stressed noun and its etymology remains open.
Ewe; unmarked vowel sequence; analyze separately from nillo sheep and ram churdi.
Ram; final stress, Purik loan.
Snake; unmarked u rather than stored o; exact central/rounded quality approximate.
Tail; final stress.
Wasp; final stress.
Apple; final stress.
Apricot; final syllable stress despite long initial aa; same phāṭir-type regional family as adjacent dialects.
Bark; final stress.
Barley; final stress, not initial. Its distinct g/n formation is not the usual yava yoo word.
Birch; two alternatives, initial stress on shorter and final stress on longer. Must retain formations separately.
Cedar/deodar; final stress, directly supports dēvadāru compound-family proposal rather than generic tree.
Fig; Persian regional loan, final stress.
Grapes; unmarked retroflex sibilants.
Grass/fodder; long vowel, unmarked.
Leaf; final stress and long ii; independently nasal parṇa-type formation rather than pattra paṭo.
Maize; two alternatives, Purik chah and regional makkii, not a single compound.
Mulberry; nasal long oo and FINAL syllable stress. Stored mateds is erroneous; primary reading supports madhuravr̥kṣa/maroṣ family comparison.
Pomegranate; final stress, Persian loan.
Poplar; final stress, comparative phaltsi/phrats regional tree set visible in other columns.
Root; final stress, geminate retroflex stop in normalized print reading.
Seed; NO acute or stress mark in Brokskat, unlike neighboring bī́ja reflexes. Stored bíi cannot count as a Brokskat accent datum.
Tree; two contact-type alternatives, both final-stressed; table laq versus source-discussion jaq remains an internal reading/transcription issue.
Walnut; final SYLLABLE stress, no acute/mora mark. Stored ac̣hoó does not establish Brokskat late mora.
Willow; final stress, Purik loan; final n in DB is velar nasal in print.
Beat; final stress in is citation form.
Bite; unmarked noun/root plus do expression, not a single inherited verb stem.
Burn intransitive; initial stress despite final is citation morphology.
